about: Shared by mods/atlas.pinboard/src/lib/pinboard/calendarEntries.test.ts (the Pinboard mod's TypeScript original, which PM's own copy was before the Pinboard became a mod) and src-tauri/src/pinboard_legacy/tests.rs (the Rust port): both must give `expected` for every case. A case may also hold `expectedNotes`, the note cards of the same board ({key, title, text, recordedCurrent}), which only the Rust reader (`pinboard_notes`, what an uninstall saves) reads: the TypeScript original has no counterpart, because the Pinboard draws its notes from the board directly. A case holds `board` (an object, written out as JSON) or `raws` (strings read as they stand, each giving `expected`). An item list may hold {"$repeat": N, "item": {...}}, which stands for N items with "{n}" in the strings replaced by 1..N. A long answer is checked by `expectedCount`, `expectedFirst` and `expectedLast`. An entry's id is <widgetId>:<itemId>.

cases.name: a freeform timeline lifts every dated entry
no board, an empty string and bad JSON give nothing
another version, or widgets that are not a list, give nothing
a version written 1.0 is version 1
undated entries are skipped, whatever the date holds
a timeline bound to a project is skipped; an empty binding is not a binding
showOnCalendar false is skipped; true and unset are shown
an empty or blank label becomes deadline
folders are walked, at any depth; notes and lists add nothing
a widget or an item without a text id is skipped
unicode labels are kept whole
trim is JavaScript's: it takes a byte-order mark and no-break spaces; U+0085 is a line break, which the tidy turns into a space and trims
a bad date is skipped, never repaired
the first and last day, and a leap day, are kept
a datetime is kept as its date
a 141-character label is cut to 140, by characters not code units, and a cut that ends in a space is trimmed
a repeated id keeps the first; the joined id is the key
entries keep board order across widgets and folders
a 2,001-entry board stops at 2,000
the 2,000-entry cap counts kept entries, not bad ones
a duplicate before the cap does not use a place
a real id is two UUIDs joined by a colon, 73 characters, and is kept
an id of 200 characters is kept and one of 201 or with a control character is skipped
a label keeps an emoji with its variation selector and joiner and a no-break space inside
a label's tab or line break becomes a space and its control and hidden characters go
whitespace of every kind is trimmed off both ends of a label, and one inside stays
a run of more than four combining marks is cut to four
a label with only an emoji joiner and selector left has nothing to show
a cut that lands after a space or leaves only joiners is tidied again
notes: a note card is read with its id, title and text
notes: folders are walked, in board order, and only note cards count
notes: a card with no text id is skipped, and a missing or non-text body is blank
notes: unicode, a --- line and a title with spaces to trim are kept whole
notes: the board's own record of an ingest is read against the text
notes: a board of another version is still read, its notes are the person's words
notes: malformed boards give no notes
